new.md:
Returns a newly created `GtkGesture` that recognizes
pinch/zoom gestures.

doc.md:
Recognizes 2-finger pinch/zoom gestures.

Whenever the distance between both tracked sequences changes, the
[`GestureZoom::scale-changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureZoom#event:scale-changed) signal is emitted to report
the scale factor.

get_scale_delta.md:
Gets the scale delta.

If `gesture` is active, this function returns the zooming
difference since the gesture was recognized (hence the
starting point is considered 1:1). If `gesture` is not
active, 1 is returned.

scale-changed.brief: Emitted whenever the distance between both tracked sequences changes.
scale-changed.md: Emitted whenever the distance between both tracked sequences changes.
